claims.text: Cyclosporine 3 to 5 mg/kg orally once/day inhibits CD8 T cells; it has shortened active disease (eg, by 2 to 3 days in some cases) and may lower mortality.
claims.quote: Cyclosporine (3 to 5 mg/kg orally once/day) inhibits CD8 T cells and has been shown to decrease the duration of active disease (eg, by 2 to 3 days in some instances) and possibly decrease mortality (3).

claims.text: The role of immunomodulators is uncertain, with limited evidence
claims.quote: The role of systemic immunomodulatory therapy is uncertain and supported by limited evidence.
